Australian Bureau of Statist: Census of Population and Housing - Counts of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians, 2021
Table 2.4: Census counts by Indigenous status, Australian Capital Territory, Indigenous Regions, 2011-2021
Data is based on place of usual residence. Excludes overseas visitors.
(a) The Indigenous Structure is a geographical standard for the publication and analysis of statistics about the Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples of Australia.

Statistical Areas Level 1 (SA1s) aggregate to Indigenous Locations which aggregate to Indigenous Areas, and they in turn aggregate to Indigenous Regions. At each hierarchical level, all of Geographic Australia is covered without gaps or overlaps.
For further information, see the Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3.

(b) This table provides 2011 and 2016 Census data on 2021 IREG boundaries to allow for direct comparisons to the 2021 Census. As a result, the 2011 and 2016 Census data in this table will differ to previously published 2011 and 2016 Census data.
(c) Includes Migratory-Offshore-Shipping and No Usual Address.

Please note that there are small random adjustments made to all cell values to protect the confidentiality of data. These adjustments may cause the sum of rows or columns to differ by small amounts from table totals.
